title: Logix Catalog Gowin FPGAs
description: The Gowin FPGAs of Logix Catalog (www.openlogix.org/catalog/): the schema of fpgas/gw1n.json, fpgas/gw2a.json and fpgas/gw5a.json, one file per family, each mapping FPGA IDs to their facts. A file's name gives its FPGAs' family.

propertyNames.description: "$schema", or an FPGA ID: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as ice40hx8k-ct256.

Fpga.description: One Gowin FPGA: its part, its size and the names the toolchain uses for it.

part_number.description: The vendor's part number, such as ICE40HX4K-TQ144.

nextpnr_device.description: The device nextpnr-himbaechel uses (--device), such as GW1NR-LV9QN88PC6/I5.

nextpnr_family.description: The die nextpnr-himbaechel uses (-o family=), such as GW1N-9C, when nextpnr can't tell it from nextpnr_device. Optional.

packer_device.description: The device gowin_pack uses (-d), such as GW1N-9C.

jtag_idcode.description: The FPGA's JTAG ID code as openFPGALoader's --detect reports it: 0x and 8 lowercase hex digits. It identifies the chip, so FPGAs made from the same chip share it. Optional: without it, tools can't check the connected FPGA before programming over JTAG.
